title: Field-extension precomposition is injective on scheme points
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, let $K,L$ be fields in its universe, and let $\alpha:K\to L$ be a field homomorphism [def-pc-field-extension]. For morphisms $y_1,y_2:\operatorname{Spec}K\to X$, the equality $y_1\circ\operatorname{Spec}\alpha=y_2\circ\operatorname{Spec}\alpha$ implies $y_1=y_2$.

proof.text: Apply the existing proved declaration AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.SpecMap_comp_injective alpha to the assumed equality. The source proof observes that both points have the same image, factors both through the same residue-field spectrum, and cancels the injective field map alpha on the resulting residue-field homomorphisms.
